account_recovery_tokens_email_only_on_re.name: account_recovery_tokens_email_only_on_revert
account_recovery_tokens_email_only_on_re.value: ("account_recovery_tokens"."kind" = 'revert-email-change') = ("account_recovery_tokens"."email_cipher" IS NOT NULL AND "account_recovery_tokens"."email_index" IS NOT NULL)

campaign_members_role_before_needs_jugge.name: campaign_members_role_before_needs_juggernaut
campaign_members_role_before_needs_jugge.value: "campaign_members"."role_before_juggernaut" is null or "campaign_members"."juggernaut_since" is not null

library_image_presentations_complete.name: library_image_presentations_complete
library_image_presentations_complete.value: ("library_image_presentations"."presentation_id" IS NULL AND "library_image_presentations"."image_id" IS NULL AND "library_image_presentations"."name_at_presentation" IS NULL) OR ("library_image_presentations"."presentation_id" IS NOT NULL AND "library_image_presentations"."image_id" IS NOT NULL AND "library_image_presentations"."name_at_presentation" IS NOT NULL)

token_forms_size_half_cells.name: token_forms_size_half_cells
token_forms_size_half_cells.value: "token_forms"."width" BETWEEN 0.5 AND 10 AND "token_forms"."height" BETWEEN 0.5 AND 10 AND ("token_forms"."width" * 2) = floor("token_forms"."width" * 2) AND ("token_forms"."height" * 2) = floor("token_forms"."height" * 2)

tokens_sight_range.name: tokens_sight_range
tokens_sight_range.value: ("tokens"."sight_bright" IS NULL AND "tokens"."sight_dim" IS NULL) OR ("tokens"."sight_bright" IS NOT NULL AND "tokens"."sight_dim" IS NOT NULL AND "tokens"."sight_bright" BETWEEN 0 AND 100 AND "tokens"."sight_dim" BETWEEN 0 AND 100)

tokens_light_range.name: tokens_light_range
tokens_light_range.value: ("tokens"."light_bright" IS NULL AND "tokens"."light_dim" IS NULL) OR ("tokens"."light_bright" IS NOT NULL AND "tokens"."light_dim" IS NOT NULL AND "tokens"."light_bright" BETWEEN 0 AND 100 AND "tokens"."light_dim" BETWEEN 0 AND 100)

tokens_light_color.name: tokens_light_color
tokens_light_color.value: "tokens"."light_color" IS NULL OR "tokens"."light_bright" IS NOT NULL

tokens_aura_shape.name: tokens_aura_shape
tokens_aura_shape.value: ("tokens"."aura_kind" IS NULL AND "tokens"."aura_radius" IS NULL AND "tokens"."aura_color" IS NULL AND "tokens"."aura_effect" IS NULL AND "tokens"."aura_image_asset_id" IS NULL AND "tokens"."aura_opacity" IS NULL AND "tokens"."aura_image_shape" IS NULL) OR ("tokens"."aura_kind" IS NOT NULL AND "tokens"."aura_radius" IS NOT NULL AND "tokens"."aura_opacity" IS NOT NULL AND "tokens"."aura_radius" BETWEEN 0 AND 20 AND "tokens"."aura_opacity" BETWEEN 10 AND 100)

tokens_aura_fields.name: tokens_aura_fields
tokens_aura_fields.value: ("tokens"."aura_kind" IS DISTINCT FROM 'color' OR "tokens"."aura_color" IS NOT NULL) AND (("tokens"."aura_effect" IS NOT NULL) = ("tokens"."aura_kind" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'effect')) AND ("tokens"."aura_color" IS NULL OR "tokens"."aura_kind" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'color' OR "tokens"."aura_kind" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'effect') AND ("tokens"."aura_image_asset_id" IS NULL OR "tokens"."aura_kind" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'image') AND (("tokens"."aura_image_shape" IS NOT NULL) = ("tokens"."aura_kind" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'image'))

tokens_box_half_cells.name: tokens_box_half_cells
tokens_box_half_cells.value: "tokens"."col" >= 0 AND "tokens"."row" >= 0 AND "tokens"."width" BETWEEN 0.5 AND 10 AND "tokens"."height" BETWEEN 0.5 AND 10 AND ("tokens"."col" * 2) = floor("tokens"."col" * 2) AND ("tokens"."row" * 2) = floor("tokens"."row" * 2) AND ("tokens"."width" * 2) = floor("tokens"."width" * 2) AND ("tokens"."height" * 2) = floor("tokens"."height" * 2)
